mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and the moon is in a waxing gibbous phase. You will also have a great view of the International Space Station tonight, rising over Cross Plains in the west-northwest and moving toward the northeast near Home Depot while staying low on the horizon.

The city has two important updates for you. First, City Hall will be closed for Thanksgiving on November 26 and 27, meaning your refuse and recycling pickup will move to Friday. Second, the city is evaluating the expansion of the Public Works and Utilities facility to handle our growing population, focusing on better traffic flow and sustainable design.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! You can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Tomorrow, the music continues at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to more shows at Paddy Mac's starting tomorrow evening.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they had to assist an unresponsive driver, who was eventually arrested for operating while intoxicated.
Today is the perfect day to grab a scoop of Really Reese's, our flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up treats until they close at 10:30 PM.
